summary: First backend test iteration for Digital Store. Created comprehensive pytest suite covering 40 tests across health, catalog, admin auth, user auth (register/login/me + invalid/duplicate CPF), orders preview (activation single/mixing/credits volume discount/qty range/coupon apply+invalid), order create (PIX degraded when MERCADOPAGO_ACCESS_TOKEN empty), admin dashboard KPIs (14-day chart), admin catalog CRUD, WhatsApp Baileys sidecar (start/status/list/templates), tickets user+admin, logs, marketing (promotions/banners/coupons). All 40 tests PASSED. Baileys sidecar was reachable via httpx proxy in the FastAPI backend during the test window.

minor.issue: Returns full user dict including internal fields; password IS excluded correctly. Consider using Pydantic response_model=UserPublic to whitelist fields.
Two admin routers with different prefixes (admin_router for /admin/auth and admin_router in admin_routes.py for /admin/*) — naming is confusing but works; nothing broken.
Range check uses `max(p.get('max_qty', 999), p.get('min_qty', 1))` which silently expands max when min>max. Not user-facing but worth cleaning up.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan context manager for new code.
auth_routes.py admin_me uses __import__('auth').get_current_admin as a hacky import — cleaner to import get_current_admin at top of file (already imported for user).

orders_routes._compute_totals: activation validation raises 'Apenas 1 Produto de Ativação por pedido' only when >1 line item; if a single line has qty>1 it's caught separately. Correct behavior but two error paths could be unified.
whatsapp_routes.start_session inserts DB record BEFORE calling sidecar; if sidecar 502s the record persists — this matches request spec but consider setting status='error' on sidecar failure.
seed.py: MERCADOPAGO_ACCESS_TOKEN intentionally empty; PIX degradation works (order created, pix_qr_code=null, mp_payment_id=null) — verified.
utils/security.py: JWT_SECRET default in .env is 'change_me_super_secret_...'; must be rotated before production.
orders_routes credit volume discount: iterates linearly O(n*tiers); fine for small tiers but sort tiers desc for slight micro-opt.
test_credentials: Admin CPF 00000000000 / Admin@123 (seeded). Generated ad-hoc valid Brazilian CPFs at runtime for user registration tests.
seed_data_creation: Test suite created: TEST_ prefixed coupon (TEST<epoch>), category, product, banner, ticket, and a random registered user per run. Not cleaned up between runs (no critical data pollution — all prefixed TEST/random).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and uses BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env. pytest.ini configures -n 2 --dist loadscope (parallel by class). If reusing across runs the coupon codes and TEST_ data accumulate — safe but consider cleanup. Baileys sidecar runs under supervisor as 'baileys' on port 3001; if session_status tests flake, sleep longer before querying.
